98: Mai Tokiha thought she had enough trouble in life between taking care of her ailing brother and transferring to a new school. But when she saves a mysterious girl wielding a sword, everything changes. A power awakens within her and she becomes a HiME, a battle princess! But she’s not alone with this power—eleven other girls share her fate, and the burden is a heavy one.

Mai Tokiha pensava di avere abbastanza problemi nella vita tra prendersi cura di suo fratello malato e trasferirsi in una nuova scuola. Ma quando salva una ragazza misteriosa che impugna una spada, tutto cambia. Un potere si risveglia dentro di lei e lei diventa una HiME, una principessa da battaglia! Ma lei non è sola con questo potere, altre ragazze condividono il suo destino, e il peso è pesante.
162: Kotarou was pretty much supposed to be your average boy, worried about the pressures of education while enjoying a simple life with his friends. Much to his despair, he one day finds the overly cheerful Misha at his door, asking to be friends out of nowhere. Even more shocking is that Misha is an apprentice angel, yet she does more bad then good. Along with Kotarou's school friends Takashi and Koboshi and the so called devil Shia (once again being able to do more good then bad), the group of friends spend their days getting into all sorts of adventures and troubles. Based on the manga by Koge-Donbo.
226: The Diclonius, a mutated homosapien that is said to be selected by God and will eventually become the destruction of mankind, possess two horns on their heads and have a "sixth sense" which gives them telekinetic abilities. Due to this dangerous power, they have been captured and isolated in laboratories by the government. Lucy, a young and psychotic Diclonius, manages to break free of her confines and brutally murders most of the guards in the laboratory where she is being held, only to be shot in the head as she makes her escape. She survives, falling off a cliff into the ocean and manages to drift along to a beach where two teenagers, Kouta and Yuka, discover her. Having lost her memories, she was named after the only thing that she can now say, "Nyuu," and the two allow her to stay at Kouta's home. However, it appears that the psychotic side of Lucy is not dead just yet...

Il Diclonio, un omosapien mutato che si dice essere scelto da Dio e che alla fine diventerà la distruzione dell'umanità, possiede due corna sulla loro testa e hanno un "sesto senso" che dà loro abilità telecinetiche. A causa di questo potere pericoloso, sono stati catturati e isolati nei laboratori dal governo. Lucy, una giovane e psicotica Diclonius, riesce a liberarsi dai suoi confini e uccide brutalmente la maggior parte delle guardie del laboratorio dove viene tenuta, solo per essere colpita in testa mentre fa la sua fuga. Sopravvive, cadendo da una scogliera nell'oceano e riesce a defluire lungo una spiaggia dove due adolescenti, Kouta e Yuka, la scoprono. Dopo aver perso i suoi ricordi, è stata chiamata dopo l'unica cosa che ora può dire, "Nyuu," e i due le permettono di rimanere a casa di Kouta. Tuttavia, sembra che il lato psicotico di Lucy non sia ancora morto...
290:
The story follows Jinto, whose world was taken over by the largest empire in the galaxy: the Abh. Jinto's father, the planet's prime minister, handed their world over to the Abh in exchange for a standing in the Abh Empire. As a result, Jinto became a prince and was shipped off for an Abh Education. There he meets a princess of the Abh Empire, Lafiel, whom he quickly befriends despite her cold exterior. The Abh Empire is plunged into war soon after and the story continues from there...

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: The last episode aired with a runtime of ~40 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

La storia segue Jinto, il cui mondo è stato preso in mano dal più grande impero della galassia: l'Abh. Il padre di Jinto, il primo ministro del pianeta, ha consegnato il loro mondo all'Abh in cambio di una posizione nell'Impero Abh. Di conseguenza, Jinto divenne un principe e venne spedito per un'educazione Abh. Lì incontra una principessa dell'Impero Abh, Lafiel, che si fa subito amicizia nonostante il suo freddo aspetto. L'Impero Abh è immerso in guerra subito dopo e la storia continua da lì...

(Fonte: Anime News Network)

Nota: L'ultimo episodio è stato trasmesso con un runtime di ~40 minuti rispetto allo standard episodio di 24 minuti.
354: During a monster attack on the city, which is something that happens quite often, Silk and her two friends try get close to the attacking monster for a better view. An unfortunate choice of location to watch from leads to UFO-man, the city's giant protector, to land on the girls crushing them to death. Feeling sorry, UFO-man blames their death on the monster and promises to bring Silk and her friends back to life by lending them his power but the catch is that they now have to become the city's protector as well.
418: It's just another day at the Tendo Anything-Goes Martial Arts Training Hall - that is, until a strange girl named Lychee and her giant elephant Jasmine arrive to settle a score with lecherous martial arts master Happosai. Apparently, a very long time ago, Happosai gave Lychee's great-grandmother half of a legendary scroll guaranteed to bring happiness to whoever was holding it. The women of Lychee's family have been waiting for three generations now, and the prince STILL hasn't come - but of course, the moment Lychee lets the scroll out of her hands, the prince finally appears. Only now it's Ranma's reluctant fiancee Akane Tendo that's holding the scroll, and the long-awaited prince is only too ready to sweep his lucky bride off her feet. Now Ranma and Co. have no choice but to follow Prince Kirin's majestic flying barge all the way to Nekonron, China, where they find themselves in a showdown with the Seven Lucky Gods of martial arts!
482:
Duel Academy, one of the most prestigious schools in Duel Monsters history. There, students learn the fundamentals of becoming not just duelists, but large business owners.

Judai Yuki is a new student with only one thing on his mind: to become the next King of Games. Judai meets several friends, teachers, and even enemies at the large Dueling school. There, he'll have to face off against several different dorms—Slifer Red, Ra Yellow, and Obelisk Blue—to become the number one duelist. Will Judai be able to pass all of them?

Based on Kazuki Takahashi's world-famous anime and manga, Yu-Gi-Oh!.

Duel Academy, una delle scuole più prestigiose della storia dei Duel Monsters. Lì, gli studenti imparano i fondamenti di diventare non solo duellanti, ma grandi imprenditori.

Judai Yuki è un nuovo studente con una sola cosa in mente: diventare il prossimo Re dei Giochi. Judai incontra diversi amici, insegnanti e persino nemici nella grande scuola Duellante. Lì, dovrà affrontare diversi dormitori diversi, Rosso, Giallo Ra e Obelisco Blue, per diventare il duellante numero uno. Judai sarà in grado di passarli tutti?

Basato sul famoso anime e manga di Kazuki Takahashi, Yu-Gi-Oh!.
546:
Okano Makoto transferred to the school in his home town. There, he spent normal but happy school days with his sister, Hinata, a jokey classmate, Tachibana Tsutomu, Shikouin Kasumi, Tsutomu's childhood friend, and other friends.

One day, after school, Makoto heard someone playing the harmonica. That melody made him feel something old, and it brought him to the roof of the school buildings. There, he met a girl in the dusk.

It was Narukaze Minamo who turned her face to him with a smile. She was a childhood friend, but they had lived separately for years.

Hiding their true thoughts, Makoto and his friends spend their lives in school. Their stories in a mysterious town are about to begin.
610:
Beautiful sisters Ai, Mai, Mii, their android maid Mea and slippery pet ferret Unagi make an amazing journey together through time and space without ever leaving their beloved mansion behind! Following the clues of the strange dandelion-like "Popotan," the girls are theoretically seeking the person who has the answers to their most personal questions, but they seem to have more than enough time to take side trips, meet new friends, visit hot springs and occasionally operate the X-mas shop they keep in the house along the way!

Yet, the girls' ultimate destiny holds more than a few surprises of its own, and not every moment is filled with hilarity, as moving through time means having to leave friends behind as well.

Belle sorelle Ai, Mai, Mii, la loro cameriera androide Mea e pet ferret scivoloso Unagi fare un viaggio incredibile insieme nel tempo e nello spazio senza mai lasciare la loro amata villa dietro! Seguendo gli indizi dello strano "Popotan" simile a un dente di leone, le ragazze stanno teoricamente cercando la persona che ha le risposte alle loro domande più personali, ma sembrano avere più che tempo per fare delle escursioni, incontrare nuovi amici, visitare le sorgenti termali e occasionalmente operare il negozio di natale che tengono in casa lungo il cammino!

Eppure, il destino finale delle ragazze contiene più di alcune sorprese, e non ogni momento è pieno di ilarità, come muoversi nel tempo significa dover lasciare anche gli amici.
738: Dreaming of a magical world every night, the young Toramizu Ginta yearns to be able to go there. With only his friend Koyuki believing in his dreams, Ginta remains positive despite the slander he receives from others over his dreams. But his wishes are answered, as one day a large door appears in front of Ginta, summoning him to the land of MAR Heaven. In this land, the weapons known as ARMS exist. While initially Ginta greatly enjoyed the discovery of this magical world, he soon learns of the terrible wars that have once plagued MAR Heaven and the upcoming war that may soon appear.

Sognando un mondo magico ogni notte, il giovane Toramizu Ginta desidera poterci andare. Con solo il suo amico Koyuki che crede nei suoi sogni, Ginta rimane positiva nonostante la calunnia che riceve dagli altri sui suoi sogni. Ma i suoi desideri sono esauditi, come un giorno una grande porta appare di fronte a Ginta, chiamandolo alla terra di Mar Cielo. In questa terra esistono le armi conosciute come ARMS. Mentre inizialmente Ginta godeva molto della scoperta di questo mondo magico, ben presto apprende delle terribili guerre che un tempo hanno tormentato MAR Heaven e la prossima guerra che presto potrebbe apparire.
866: Lina and Gourry travel to a seaside town named Acassi, where octopus tentacle is a delicacy. However, the octopus meat carries a curse that dooms the eater to only speak Takogo (octopus language). Amelia, Zelgadiss, and Xelloss all show up, and the main four characters (Lina, Gourry, Ameria, Zelgadiss) get cursed. The octopi enlist the power of a mazoku to get rid of the humans once and for all. The white sorceress Ruma must learn the cure to the curse from her long-lost master in order to save the town.
930: From the continuing reclamation of the ruins of the planet Solo, mysterious mechas are excavated. But suddenly, an alien called Buff Clan attacks seeking the limitless energy “Ide.” The earthlings are backed into a corner, when the three mechas piloted by the earth boy Yuki Cosmo and others fuse together. Becoming the giant robot Ideon, they use their incredible power to fight back against Buff Clan.

Dalla continua bonifica delle rovine del pianeta Solo, misteriosi mechas sono scavati. Ma improvvisamente, un alieno chiamato Buff Clan attacchi alla ricerca dell'energia illimitata I terrestri sono appoggiati in un angolo, quando i tre mechas pilotati dal ragazzo della terra Yuki Cosmo e altri si fondono insieme. Diventando il gigantesco robot Ideon, usano il loro incredibile potere per combattere contro il Buff Clan.
994: It is raining in the Tokyo at night. A woman is wandering soaked to the skin. Her name is Kimura Yu. She had a trauma that her parents were killed, and she experienced another tragedy that her reliable councilor, Kanzaki, was killed miserably. The person who suddenly appears in the rain and saves Yu is a detective, Takamizawa Kyosuke.
1058: Set in the Meiji era, Kidou Shinsengumi Moeyo Ken tells the story of Kondou Yuuko, Hijikata Toshie and Okita Kaoru. These three are the daughters of former Shinsengumi members and, in the same fashion as their fathers were, they get called upon to protect Japan from its current problems. Much of their work deals with vanquishing the mysterious paranormal phenomena springing up ever more frequently in the Kyoto area and defending the city from any other dangers that may arise.
1122: Satoshi and his friends travel to LaRousse, where they meet a boy named Tooi who is afraid of Pokemon due to an incident that happened four years earlier. Meanwhile, Deoxys, a Pokemon from space, has reappeared, putting a barrier around the city and kidnapping people. Rayquaza, a Pokemon that lives in the atmosphere, comes to fight it.

Satoshi e i suoi amici si recano a LaRousse, dove incontrano un ragazzo di nome Tooi che ha paura di Pokemon a causa di un incidente avvenuto quattro anni prima. Nel frattempo, Deoxys, un Pokemon dallo spazio, è ricomparso, mettendo una barriera intorno alla città e rapire la gente. Rayquaza, un Pokemon che vive nell'atmosfera, viene a combatterlo.
1186: Akari Kanzaki has just joined an all-girls academy in hopes of entering the University Satellite, an elite sports training facility. She wants to win the title of Cosmo Beauty - a title held years ago by her mother. It's not an easy task for her as fear, doubt and peer pressure get in her way, but friends, rivals and fans slowly encourage her to overcome her obstacles and become the best of the Battle Athletes.
1250: After a routine raid, the rookie sky pirate Coud finds a most unusual cargo in his mates' cargo hold: Ren, an "Edel Reid", a race prized by humans for granting special combat power to their partners through "Reacting". He quickly discovers, however, that Ren is even more prized than he expected. The pirate ship is visited by three members of the Edel Reid Complete Protection Agency "Arc Aire", who try to purchase her. When Coud refuses, the ship is suddenly attacked by a mysterious force, and Coud's captain charges him with Ren's protection.

Dopo un'incursione di routine, il pirata del rookie sky Coud trova un carico molto insolito nella stiva dei suoi compagni: Ren, un "Edel Reid," una corsa premiata dagli umani per aver concesso un potere speciale ai loro partner attraverso "Reaction." Scopre rapidamente, tuttavia, che Ren è ancora più apprezzato di quanto si aspettasse. La nave pirata è visitata da tre membri della Edel Reid Complete Protection Agency "Arc Aire," che cercano di acquistarla. Quando Coud si rifiuta, la nave viene improvvisamente attaccata da una forza misteriosa, e il capitano di Coud lo accusa con la protezione di Ren.
1314: Shu is from Datania, a country that makes young children work. He and his friends were trying to escape when they met the Returners. The Returners are some kind of rebels to Datania. Shu goes with the Returners to fight Zero, Nines, and his men who are after DT, a special substance inside humans.
1378:
The year a comet races across the sky, splitting the heavens, from the depths of the Earth the dark god shall arise once again. Then, the dark evil lurking in the shadows shall come out of the depths of Hell and show itself in the present world. The emotions of the blade of the wind shall collect at the source of the blue light. And the three blades shall become one, vanquishing evil.

The year is 1580, and the unholy armies of Lord Nobunaga Oda steadily spread across Japan. Narrowly escaping the slaughter of her clan, a young ninja steals into the shadows. She is Ayame, the last of the Kasumi clan, and the dagger she wields is one of three, mystical blades. She is joined by Sakon and Ryoma, renegade ninja and the possessors of the sacred sword and spear. Now, these shadow warriors must unite their weapons and skills to fulfill `The Prophesy of the Enchanted Swords` or die trying...

This is a cut version of the earlier OVA.
1442: Prince Alexander, son of King Philip, and heir to the Macedonian empire, must fend off political saboteurs, assassins, and the jealousy of his own father to ascend to the position of king. Once there, he begins his quest to conquer all nations and become known as the Great King, though an ancient prophecy foretells that he will be the destroyer of the world and forever remembered as the Devil King.
1506:
After receiving a strange invitation, Kogorou Mouri pays a visit to the Miracle Land theme park along with his daughter Ran, Conan Edogawa, and the Detective Boys. Once there, Kogorou and Conan are tasked with finishing an unsolved case by a mysterious stranger. Realizing that the invitations were actually an elaborate trap, the two have just 12 hours to solve the case or face grave danger.

With the help of familiar faces like Heiji Hattori, Kaitou Kid, and even Saguru Hakuba, the group of detectives must unravel the web of clues surrounding the case in order to find the culprit and bring them to justice before it's too late.

Dopo aver ricevuto uno strano invito, Kogorou Mouri fa una visita al parco a tema Miracle Land insieme a sua figlia Ran, Conan Edogawa e i Detective Boys. Una volta lì, Kogorou e Conan sono incaricati di finire un caso irrisolto da un misterioso sconosciuto. Capire che gli inviti erano in realtà una trappola elaborata, i due hanno solo 12 ore per risolvere il caso o affrontare gravi pericoli.

Con l'aiuto di volti familiari come Heiji Hattori, Kaitou Kid, e anche Saguru Hakuba, il gruppo di detective deve svelare la rete di indizi che circondano il caso per trovare il colpevole e portarli alla giustizia prima che sia troppo tardi.
1570: Kamizaka Haruhi having been rescued when she was young by a mage, longed to be a mage herself, so she enrolled into a special school that allows regular and magic classes into two different sections. Together with her rival/best friend, Hiiragi Anri, they study magic together while she is searching for the boy that saved her years ago, to give him a Valentines' chocolate.

Kamizaka Haruhi è stata salvata quando era giovane da un mago, desiderava essere un mago lei stessa, quindi si è iscritta in una scuola speciale che permette classi regolari e magiche in due sezioni diverse. Insieme alla sua rivale/ migliore amica, Hiiragi Anri, studiano insieme la magia mentre lei sta cercando il ragazzo che l'ha salvata anni fa, per dargli una cioccolata di San Valentino.
1698:
Shinichi Chiaki is a first class musician whose dream is to play among the elites in Europe. Coming from a distinguished family, he is an infamous perfectionist; not only is he highly critical of himself, but of others as well. The only thing stopping Chiaki from leaving for Europe is his fear of flying. As a result, he's grounded in Japan.

During his 4th year at Japan's top music university, Chiaki happens to meet Noda Megumi; or as she refers to herself, Nodame. On the surface, she seems to be an unkempt girl with no direction in life. However, when Chiaki hears Nodame play the piano for the first time, he is in awe at the kind of music she plays. To Chiaki's dismay, Nodame moves into the apartment next to his and finds out that she is head over heels in love with him.

Nodame Cantabile tells the story of Chiaki and Nodame, as they not only learn to deal with each other, but learn lessons from one another as they strive for the top of the musical world.

Shinichi Chiaki è un musicista di prima classe il cui sogno è suonare tra le élite in Europa. Provenendo da una famiglia distinta, egli è un famigerato perfezionista; non solo è altamente critico verso se stesso, ma anche verso gli altri. L'unica cosa che impedisce a Chiaki di partire per l'Europa è la sua paura di volare. Di conseguenza, è in punizione in Giappone.

Durante il suo quarto anno alla top music university giapponese, Chiaki incontra Noda Megumi; o come lei si riferisce a se stessa, Nodame. In superficie, sembra essere una ragazza insicura senza direzione nella vita. Tuttavia, quando Chiaki sente Nodame suonare il pianoforte per la prima volta, è in soggezione per il tipo di musica che suona. Con sgomento di Chiaki, Nodame si trasferisce nell'appartamento accanto al suo e scopre che è innamorata di lui.

Nodame Cantabile racconta la storia di Chiaki e Nodame, poiché non solo imparano ad avere a che fare con l'altro, ma imparano lezioni l'una dall'altra mentre lottano per la parte superiore del mondo musicale.
1762: Betrayed from within and overwhelmed by dark sorcery, the valiant armies of Pars are overrun by the warrior-fanatics of Rucitania. Escaping the destruction of his homeland, the heroic Prince Arislan begins to assemble a group of five, extraordinary allies — a priestess, an exiled warrior, a mischievous minstrel, an insightful artist and his attendant — to aid him in his fight against the Rucitanian invaders. Together, they must build an army and defeat 300,000 trained soldiers — including the mysterious Lord Silver Mask — who has also laid claim to the throne of Pars...

Tradito dall'interno e travolto dalla stregoneria oscura, i valorosi eserciti di Pars sono invasi dai guerrieri-fanatici di Rucitania. Scappando dalla distruzione della sua patria, l'eroico principe Arislan inizia a radunare un gruppo di cinque, alleati straordinari Insieme, essi devono costruire un esercito e sconfiggere 300.000 soldati addestrati tra cui il misterioso Lord Silver Mask che ha anche fatto richiesta al trono di Pars...
1826: The evil Shadow Lord has taken control of the kingdom of Deltora and has driven the land and its people into misfortune and suffering. Lief, the son of a blacksmith, has just turned sixteen and is entrusted, along with his two companions Barda and Jasmine, with an important mission: to retrieve the stolen seven magical stones that once reunited within the Belt of Deltora, will bring power to the true heir of Deltora and give him the power to free the kingdom from the tyranny of the Shadow Lord. There is just one problem; the seven stones have been scattered all across Deltora and currently reside in the hands of seven wicked men who are not easily willing to give them up.

Il malvagio Signore dell'Ombra ha preso il controllo del regno di Deltora e ha spinto la terra e il suo popolo in disgrazia e sofferenza. Lief, figlio di un fabbro, ha appena compiuto sedici anni ed è incaricato, insieme ai suoi due compagni Barda e Gelsomino, di una importante missione: recuperare le sette pietre magiche rubate che un tempo riunite nella Cintura di Deltora, porteranno il potere al vero erede di Deltora e gli darà il potere di liberare il regno dalla tirannia del Signore Ombra. C'è solo un problema: le sette pietre sono state sparse in tutta Deltora e attualmente risiedono nelle mani di sette malvagi che non sono facilmente disposti a rinunciarvi.
1954:
The Earth lies darkened and deserted. Despite the best efforts of the film's heroine, Hikaru, the evil-filled castle of Cephiro has taken over the world and stands in the center of a lifeless Tokyo. Before the ice-witch Alcyone can take her revenge on Hikaru, she is rescued by Lantis, a young man who seals her into a magical maze where she is challenged to prove her powers while her friends are hunted down by Cephiro's warlocks.

Fleeing through the silent city, Umi and Fuu must seek out the sleeping Mashin; godlike creatures that will fuse with them to form giant warriors of awesome destructive power. But the Magic Knights are afraid, untrained and alone... will even the Mashin be enough to save them from the evil acts of Cephiro?

Note: During 1998 Toshihiro Hirano released a Director's cut called "Special Edition - The Wings of Hope", including the three episodes in a two-hour movie with some new scenes and dialogue changes
2018: Yuzuru was an average teenager who had almost forgotten that he was betrothed to Azusa when he was only 6! Now arriving to claim what she feels is rightfully hers, only Satomi (Yuzuru's current girlfriend) stands in her way... and with the mysterious and frightening powers that Azusa brings, Satomi won't stand in her way for long!
2082:
The OVA anime release Marriage consists of two 30-minute pieces by Miki Kasamatsu on the topics of love and looking for that special someone.

The first deals with a group of young women who, after being out of school for a few years, are beginning to think about settling down. However, there is one member of the group who has no prospects, and Shizuka's friends are worried that her shyness will keep Mr. Right from noticing her beauty and character. They persuade her to join a dating service called The Wedding Club, but when her first match seems to be quite a dud, Shizuka wonders if a trip down the isle just isn't in her future.

The second episode is about five sisters, only one of whom isn't married. What's more, the cool Kiyomi seems to have no interest whatsoever in finding a husband. Her sisters have other ideas, though, and when a co-worker asks her out on a date, the women convince the suitor to propose marriage that very night.This is easier said than done, however, as Kiyomi's attitude can be quite intimidating.
The young man may not end up following through with the plan, but even if he does there is no guarantee that the headstrong lady in question will say yes.
2146: Mika Katagiri wants her band to perform at the upcoming local festival. However, complications arise. Their keyboardist, Jun, refuses to play, and their stage has been cancelled. Refusing to give up, Mika and her band strive to find a way to play at the festival, using any means necessary.
2210: A man and a woman, talking over their relationship.
2402: Joe, a teenage orphan in the slums of the Doya streets, meets Danpei, a homeless, alcoholic ex-boxing coach. Danpei, seeing Joe's boxing talent, decides to train him. When Joe is sent to a terrible juvenile home for petty crimes, he meets Rikiishi who becomes his boxing rival. Danpei arrives at the home to help Joe to train in order to defeat Rikiishi. When Joe decides to seriously pursue boxing, Danpei cannot get a coaching license because of his reputation as a drunk.

Joe, un'orfana adolescente nelle baraccopoli delle strade di Doya, incontra Danpei, un'ex-allenatrice senza casa, alcolizzata. Danpei, vedendo il talento della boxe di Joe, decide di addestrarlo. Quando Joe viene mandato in una terribile casa minorile per crimini minorili, incontra Rikiishi che diventa il suo rivale di pugilato. Danpei arriva a casa per aiutare Joe ad allenarsi per sconfiggere Rikiishi. Quando Joe decide di perseguire seriamente la boxe, Danpei non può ottenere una licenza di coaching a causa della sua reputazione di ubriaco.
2466:
Take the characters from a number of sci-fi based animes, a stage not unlike "Wacky Races," super deformed madness, and general insanity and what you get is Scramble Wars. While Scramble Wars does include characters from the original Bubblegum Crisis, Gall Force and Genesis Survivor Gaiarth, it also has a few other characters from other animes such as AD Police and Riding Bean. It doesn't matter if you loved or hated any of these series, as long as you've seen at least one of them you'll have a great time watching this, though the insanity is so generic that it really doesn't matter if you haven't seen any of the animes featured in Scramble Wars.

Wacky Races! No not really, but close enough. Genom is holding a race; the winner will receive the Genom Trophy! Woohoo! Yay! Enter, Priss on her Motoroid, Linna and Nene, Sylia and Mackie, a Boomer... A Boomer?... okay... and characters from other animes already mentioned a million times. All will be racing against each other to win this prestigious trophy for some reason. And all of them will do anything to win it...
2594:
Amamiya Shuuhei moves from Tokyo to the country side due to his grandmother's bad health. His father is a famous pianist and Shuuhei has taken strict piano lessons since he was very young, aspiring to follow in his footsteps. In school, he is teased by his classmates and is dared to play the piano in the forest. This piano is said to be cursed: if you play it, no sound will come. After school, Ichinose Kai, a boy in the same class, takes Shuuhei to the forest. When Shuuhei tries to play he fails, but Kai plays a wonderful song.

This is the beginning of a strong friendship, and a story of two very different boys developing their skills as musicians.

Amamiya Shuuhei si trasferisce da Tokyo alla campagna a causa della cattiva salute di sua nonna. Suo padre è un famoso pianista e Shuuhei ha preso lezioni di pianoforte da quando era molto giovane, aspirando a seguire le sue orme. A scuola, viene preso in giro dai suoi compagni di classe ed è osato suonare il pianoforte nella foresta. Si dice che questo pianoforte sia maledetto: se lo suonate, non verrà alcun suono. Dopo la scuola, Ichinose Kai, un ragazzo della stessa classe, porta Shuuei nella foresta. Quando Shuuhei cerca di suonare fallisce, ma Kai suona una canzone meravigliosa.

Questo è l'inizio di una forte amicizia, e una storia di due ragazzi molto diversi che sviluppano le loro abilità come musicisti.
2658: Nobita is trying to prove that the Monkey King exists so they went back to the time Sanzo began his pilgrimage. 20770: Since Yona is the only princess of a grand kingdom, she has been raised with great care by her doting father and protected by her childhood friend/guard Hak and others. However, her fate changes on her 16th birthday, when her beloved cousin Soo-won murders her father to claim the throne. She flees the castle to Hak's hometown and begins her new life.

Dal momento che Yona è l'unica principessa di un grande regno, è stata cresciuta con grande cura dal suo papà puntino e protetta dal suo amico/guardia d'infanzia Hak e altri. Tuttavia, il suo destino cambia al suo sedicesimo compleanno, quando la sua amata cugina Soo-won uccide suo padre per rivendicare il trono. Fugge dal castello fino alla città natale di Hak e inizia la sua nuova vita.
20834: Short specials included in the BD release.
20898: A five-minute promotional anime for PlayStation Vita and PlayStation Portable game Toukiden Kiwami.
20962: Prepare your body for another infusion of international sparkle shenanigans with Hetalia: The World Twinkle! Surprise! It’s been too long since we’ve peeked into the world of our favorite nations. (Seriously, calm down, Italy!) Admit it, you could use another inva…vacation. Yeah, vacation!

Preparate il vostro corpo per un'altra infusione di brillantine internazionali con Hetalia: The World Twinkle! Sorpresa! E' stato troppo lungo da quando abbiamo sbirciato nel mondo delle nostre nazioni preferite. (Davvero, calmati, Italia!) Ammettilo, ti farebbe comodo un'altra vacanza. Si', in vacanza!
21154: The film is a compilation of all 12 episodes of the first season with new sequences and redone sound effects.
21218: When I came to, I realized I was standing in the middle of a vast, snowy plain I knew nothing of. I didn't know how I got there. And to add to that, I couldn't remember anything, not even my name. I stood there, dumbfounded at my absurd situation. But then, as if to spite me further, a gigantic monster suddenly appeared, an insect-like creature that began to bear down on me. I tried desperately to run, but it cornered me into a hopeless situation. It was then that the girl appeared. Her name was Kuon. It was this beautiful girl, who bore an animal's ears and tail, who saved my life.

Quando sono arrivato, ho capito che ero in mezzo a una vasta pianura innevata di cui non sapevo nulla. Non sapevo come ci sono arrivata. E per di più, non riuscivo a ricordare niente, nemmeno il mio nome. Ero li' impaurito per la mia assurda situazione. Ma poi, come se per dispetto di me, improvvisamente apparve un mostro gigantesco, una creatura simile a un insetto che cominciò a sopportarmi. Ho cercato disperatamente di scappare, ma mi ha messo in una situazione senza speranza. Fu allora che la ragazza apparve. Si chiamava Kuon. E' stata questa bellissima ragazza, che ha portato le orecchie e la coda di un animale, che mi ha salvato la vita.
21410: The Katvarna Empire is at war with the neighboring Republic of Kioka. In the Katvarna Empire, the lazy, woman-admiring Ikuta hates war, but due to certain circumstances, he grudgingly takes the High Grade Military Officer Exam. No one would have expected that this 17-year-old young man would eventually become a soldier called a great commander by others. Ikuta survives this world engulfed in war with his superior intellect.

L'Impero di Katvarna è in guerra con la vicina Repubblica di Kioka. Nell'Impero di Katvarna, la pigra, donna-ammiratrice Ikuta odia la guerra, ma a causa di determinate circostanze, egli si affatica con l'esame di alto grado ufficiale militare. Nessuno si sarebbe aspettato che questo diciassettenne sarebbe diventato un soldato chiamato un grande comandante da altri. Ikuta sopravvive a questo mondo inghiottito in guerra con il suo intelletto superiore.
21474: Feature the characters from the Hakuouki games in chibi form, and will feature a completely new story with the theme "A normal every day that might have existed."
21602: The story is set in a world where every event has been turned into programs, and mysterious monsters known as "Promin" maintain the world. However, many Promin who have turned into bugs known as "Bugmin" are responsible for many of the world's real-life bugs. Left alone, they may eventually turn into a big problem. The boy Yūto encounters the space dog Wanda, and the pair use a camera-like device and key items to capture Bugmin. Promin themselves are able to do things like "accelerate objects," "spew fire," or "create objects," through an ability known as "Kamiwaza" (miracle), and are able to fend off Bugmin with it. At first, the Bugmin only cause small, bothersome things, but it will soon elevate into a global scale threat. Can one boy and one dog save the world?
21666: The gag manga centers on a young female ninja named Chidori, whose dream is to help the Warring States-era warlord Oda Nobunaga to achieve his goals.

Il manga gag si concentra su una giovane ninja femminile di nome Chidori, il cui sogno è quello di aiutare il guerriero degli Stati Uniti-era signore della guerra Oda Nobunaga a raggiungere i suoi obiettivi.
21730:
Three years since the return of the legendary Space Battleship Yamato, Earth has begun rebuilding itself and has made peace with the Gamilans. However, this recovery comes at the cost of utilizing the forbidden Wave Motion technology.

Meanwhile, the notorious former crew members of the Yamato, who have each gone their separate ways, receive a psychic message from the mysterious Goddess Teresa. She urges them to return to their beloved ship and travel to the distant planet Terezart. They are promised a revolutionary power to combat the unprecedented threat of the relentless Gatlantis Empire, who are approaching Earth with all but innocent intentions.

Unable to resist her plea, the crew reassembles and sets sail on another perilous intergalactic voyage, one that will test their sheer courage and versatility in the face of an even greater foe.

Tre anni dopo il ritorno della leggendaria nave da guerra spaziale Yamato, la Terra ha iniziato a ricostruirsi e ha fatto pace con i Gamilani. Tuttavia, questo recupero viene al costo di utilizzare la tecnologia di movimento di onda proibita.

Nel frattempo, i famigerati ex membri dell'equipaggio della Yamato, che sono andati ognuno per la propria strada, ricevono un messaggio psichico dalla misteriosa dea Teresa. Lei li esorta a tornare alla loro amata nave e viaggiare sul lontano pianeta Terezart. Gli è stato promesso un potere rivoluzionario per combattere la minaccia senza precedenti dell'Impero Gatlantis implacabile, che si avvicina alla Terra con tutte le intenzioni ma innocenti.

Incapace di resistere alla sua supplica, l'equipaggio si riassembla e salpa su un altro pericoloso viaggio intergalattico, che mette alla prova il loro coraggio e la loro versatilità di fronte a un nemico ancora più grande.
21794: Sequel to Meiji Tokyo Renka: Yumihari no Serenade.
21858: In a time when magic is on the decline amid society, Atsuko Kagari is a cheerful girl who enters Luna Nova Academy in order to accomplish her dream of becoming a witch like her idol, Shiny Chariot. Shiny is a famous witch who disappeared from public view many years ago. On her way to school, Kagari meets the kind Lotte Yanson and the mischievous Sucy Manbavaran and the three become friends as they share a bedroom on campus. At the academy, Atsuko soon discovers she is at a serious disadvantage compared to the other girls since she doesn't come from a magical family and is required to learn the magical curriculum from scratch. Having found an item that once belonged to Chariot, Atsuko must discover how to activate and properly use the mysterious Shiny Rod as she hopes it might lead to finding out what has truly happened to her vanished idol.

In un momento in cui la magia è in declino nella società, Atsuko Kagari è una ragazza allegra che entra nell'Accademia di Luna Nova per realizzare il suo sogno di diventare una strega come il suo idolo, Shiny Chariot. Shiny è una strega famosa che è scomparsa dalla vista pubblica molti anni fa. Durante il viaggio a scuola, Kagari incontra la gentile Lotte Yanson e la maliziosa Sucy Manbavaran e i tre diventano amici mentre condividono una camera da letto nel campus. All'accademia, Atsuko scopre presto di essere in grave svantaggio rispetto alle altre ragazze poiché non proviene da una famiglia magica ed è tenuta a imparare il magico curriculum da zero. Avendo trovato un oggetto che apparteneva un tempo al Chariot, Atsuko deve scoprire come attivare e utilizzare correttamente il misterioso Shiny Rod come spera che possa portare a scoprire cosa è realmente accaduto al suo idolo scomparso.
87458:
The appearance of the giant living creatures “Kaiju's” and the ultimate existence that destroys all monsters, Godzilla, has incited a battle that lasted for half a century. Humanity has experienced continuous defeat, and finally plans to escape from the Earth. In 2048, only those who were selected by the A.I. managed under the central government boarded the inter-sidereal emigrant spaceship “Aratrum” to head for “Tau Cetus e”, the planet beyond the distance of 11.9 light-year. However, the environmental condition differences between that of the Earth and Tau e were considered to be inhabitable by human beings.

The young man on the emigrant ship: Haruo, who saw his parents killed by Godzilla in front of his eyes, had only one thing in his mind for 20 years: to return to the Earth and defeat Godzilla. Shut out from the possibility of emigration, as the living environment in the ship deteriorates, the group of “Earth Returnists” led by Haruo are determined to return through a dangerous long-distance hyperspace navigation. However, 20,000 years have passed on Earth since and it has become an unknown world with the ecosystem reigned by Godzilla.

L'aspetto delle creature viventi giganti di Kaiju e l'esistenza finale che distrugge tutti i mostri, Godzilla, ha incitato una battaglia che è durata per mezzo secolo. L'umanità ha sperimentato una sconfitta continua, e infine prevede di fuggire dalla Terra. Nel 2048 solo coloro che erano stati selezionati dall'A.I. gestita sotto il governo centrale si imbarcarono sull'astronave emigrata inter-siderale Tuttavia, le differenze di condizioni ambientali tra quella della Terra e quella del Tau e sono state considerate abitabili dagli esseri umani.

Il giovane sulla nave emigrante: Haruo, che vedeva i suoi genitori uccisi da Godzilla davanti ai suoi occhi, aveva solo una cosa nella sua mente per 20 anni: tornare sulla Terra e sconfiggere Godzilla. Chiudere fuori dalla possibilità di emigrazione, come l'ambiente vivo nella nave si deteriora, il gruppo di ÕEarth Returnists guidato da Haruo sono determinati a tornare attraverso una pericolosa navigazione iperspazio a lunga distanza. Tuttavia, 20.000 anni sono passati sulla Terra da allora ed è diventato un mondo sconosciuto con l'ecosistema regnato da Godzilla.
97634:
After his mom wins a free vacation trip, Satoshi and Pikachu are off on another adventure. This time in the tropical land of Alola. There they meet new friends, Pokémon and explore new islands.

We also get introduced to Z-Rings, a device used for Z-Moves. What kind of mysterious Pokémon and challenges will come their way, and why is Kapu-Kokeko so interested in our young trainer?!

Dopo che sua madre vince un viaggio di vacanza gratuito, Satoshi e Pikachu sono fuori per un'altra avventura. Questa volta nella terra tropicale di Alola. Lì incontrano nuovi amici, Pokémon ed esplorano nuove isole.

Ci vengono presentati anche gli Z-Rings, un dispositivo usato per gli Z-Moves. Che tipo di misterioso Pokémon e le sfide si faranno strada, e perché Kapu-Kokeko è così interessato al nostro giovane allenatore?!
97890:
Excited children gather around the enigmatic masked Storyteller once more. His unique kamishibai storytelling draws them into tales of fear and dread. These are dark and foreboding stories, which could happen to anyone...

This season has tales of a salaryman who buries a dead cat, only to be haunted soon after; a college student and her cheap new apartment that hides a ghastly secret; boys exploring an abandoned haunted house before coming across a strange fish tank; a man who finds himself on the wrong bus, and in more danger than he thought possible; and a young couple's visit to an amusement park, which suddenly takes a dark turn. All these stories and more await in Yami Shibai 4.

I bambini eccitati si riuniscono intorno all'enigmatico Storyteller mascherato ancora una volta. La sua storia unica di Kamishibai li attira in racconti di paura e terrore. Queste sono storie oscure e preconcetti, che potrebbero succedere a chiunque...

Questa stagione ha racconti di un uomo che seppellisce un gatto morto, solo per essere perseguitato subito dopo; uno studente universitario e il suo nuovo appartamento economico che nasconde un segreto orribile; ragazzi che esplorano una casa infestata abbandonata prima di incontrare una strana vasca di pesce; un uomo che si trova sull'autobus sbagliato, e in più pericolo di quanto pensasse possibile; e una giovane coppia visita un parco divertimenti, che improvvisamente prende una svolta scura. Tutte queste storie e molto altro ancora attendono a Yami Shibai 4.
98338: Short specials included in the Blu-ray/DVD releases.
Specialità brevi incluse nelle versioni Blu-ray/DVD.
98402: Meicoomon rampages after witnessing Meiko Mochizuki being injured by the man bearing Gennai's likeness. "It would have been better if you hadn't been born..." Meicoomon disappears into the Real World, which has since become distorted. Possessing overwhelming power, she's the key to the world's destruction.

Meicoomon fugge dopo aver visto Meiko Mochizuki essere ferito dall'uomo che portava la somiglianza di Gennai. "Sarebbe stato meglio se non fossi nato..." Meicoomon scompare nel Mondo Reale, che da allora è diventato distorto. Possedere un potere travolgente, lei è la chiave della distruzione del mondo.
98658: The franchise centers on "Starlight" — the song and dance revue troupe loved throughout the world. Karen and Hikari make a promise with each other when they're young that one day they'll stand on that stage together. Time passes, and now the girls are 16 years old. Karen is very enthusiastic about the lessons she takes every day, holding her promise close to her heart. Hikari has transferred schools and is now away from Karen. But the cogs of fate turn, and the two are destined to meet again. The girls and other "Stage Girls" will compete in a mysterious audition process to gain acceptance into the revue.

Il franchise si concentra su "Starlight" ... la canzone e la revue troupe di danza amata in tutto il mondo. Karen e Hikari fanno una promessa l'uno con l'altro quando sono giovani che un giorno staranno insieme su quel palco. Il tempo passa, e ora le ragazze hanno 16 anni. Karen è molto entusiasta delle lezioni che prende ogni giorno, mantenendo la sua promessa vicina al suo cuore. Hikari ha trasferito le scuole ed è ora lontano da Karen. Ma gli ingranaggi del destino girano, e i due sono destinati ad incontrarsi di nuovo. Le ragazze e altre "Stage Girls" si sfideranno in un misterioso processo di audizione per ottenere l'accettazione nella rivista.
98978:
The mysterious masked Storyteller returns to tell more twisted tales of horror. Continuing his particular style of kamishibai inspired storytelling, he now finds that his audience is an eerie crowd of young girls, who eagerly await his devilish stories.

He recounts ghostly legends involving girls of all ages: a housewife who receives a barrage of chilling phone calls; a strange girl whose flower readings are always right; a mother and daughter's ominous meeting with the "crow lady"; and a young girl whose demands from others grow more and more outrageous with each request. Witness once again the Storyteller's haunting and gripping tales, which are sure to leave one with more than just chills...

Il misterioso Storyteller mascherato torna a raccontare storie più contorte di orrore. Continuando il suo particolare stile di narrazione ispirata al kamishibai, ora scopre che il suo pubblico è una folla inquietante di giovani ragazze, che attendono con impazienza le sue storie diaboliche.

Racconta leggende fantasmatiche che coinvolgono ragazze di tutte le età: una casalinga che riceve una barricata di telefonate gelide; una strana ragazza le cui letture floreali sono sempre giuste; l'orribile incontro di madre e figlia con la "corona"; e una giovane ragazza le cui richieste da parte degli altri crescono sempre più scandalose ad ogni richiesta. Testimoniate ancora una volta le storie infedeli e avvincenti del Storyteller, che sicuramente ne lasceranno uno con più di un semplice brivido...
99426: Mari Tamaki is in her second year of high school and wants to start something. It's then that she meets Shirase, a girl with few friends who's considered weirdo by the rest of the class and nicknamed "Antarctic" since it's all she ever talks about. Unlike her peers, Mari is moved by Shirase's dedication and decides that even though it's unlikely that high school girls will ever go to Antarctica, she's going to try to go with Shirase.

Mari Tamaki è al suo secondo anno di liceo e vuole iniziare qualcosa. E' allora che incontra Shirase, una ragazza con pochi amici che è considerata strana dal resto della classe e soprannominata "Antartide" dal momento che non parla d'altro. A differenza dei suoi coetanei, Mari è commossa dalla dedizione di Shirase e decide che anche se è improbabile che le ragazze del liceo vadano mai in Antartide, lei cercherà di andare con Shirase.
99938: Too much tankery and not enough studying for her entrance exams has landed Momo in the hot seat! Luckily her friends won’t let her flunk out without a fight, and they’ve hatched a foxy plan to put her back on top. Miho’s stepping down to let Momo take up the mantle of commander, because if she can lead the team to victory in the Continuous Cup, Momo can retake her exams. The stakes have never been higher for the team as they fight for tank supremacy both on and off the combat field!

Troppa petroliera e non abbastanza studio per i suoi esami d'ingresso ha atterrato Momo nella sede calda! Per fortuna i suoi amici hanno vinto la sua bocciatura senza combattere, e loro hanno generato un piano foxy per rimetterla in cima. I Mihooolands si ritirano per lasciare che Momo prenda il mantello del comandante, perché se lei può condurre la squadra alla vittoria nella Coppa Continua, Momo può riprendere i suoi esami. La posta in gioco non è mai stata più alta per la squadra in quanto lottano per la supremazia dei carri armati sia in campo che fuori dal campo di combattimento!
101090: A short four-minute concept film that served as a surprise unveil at Studio SHAFT's 40th anniversary event in Winter 2015, Madogatari. The concept movie is the core of a new Madoka Magica project, and serves as its trailer. The second short was later screened in Osaka, with the difference being a replacement of several imageboard segments.

Un breve concept film di quattro minuti che ha rappresentato una sorpresa per lo Studio SHAFT 40 ° anniversario di inverno 2015, Madogatari. Il concept movie è il nocciolo di un nuovo progetto Madoka Magica, e serve come trailer. Il secondo corto è stato successivamente proiettato a Osaka, con la differenza di essere una sostituzione di diversi segmenti della scheda di immagini.
101410:
The All-Star Tournament is a three-day event that allows e-sports participants from various professional clubs to display their skills, while also giving casual Glory players the chance to interact with pros in the flesh.

Retired top-tier Glory player Ye Xiu agrees to watch the tournament together with Tang Rou and Chen Guo after the latter manages to get ahold of three tickets. It is a strange sensation for Ye Xiu, as unlike previous occasions, this time he attends the tournament as a spectator, not a participant. However, despite his attempts to keep a low profile, events in the All-Star Tournament may force the former Glory legend back into the limelight.

L'All-Star Tournament è un evento di tre giorni che consente ai partecipanti e-sport di vari club professionisti di mostrare le loro abilità, dando anche ai giocatori casual Glory la possibilità di interagire con i professionisti in carne ed ossa.

Il giocatore di livello superiore in pensione Glory Ye Xiu accetta di guardare il torneo insieme a Tang Rou e Chen Guo dopo che quest'ultimo riesce a prendere tre biglietti. È una strana sensazione per Ye Xiu, come a differenza delle precedenti occasioni, questa volta partecipa al torneo come spettatore, non come partecipante. Tuttavia, nonostante i suoi tentativi di mantenere un basso profilo, gli eventi del Torneo All-Star possono costringere l'ex leggenda della Gloria a tornare alla ribalta.
101474: With his foundations now set in this new world, the first steps of Ains Ooal Gown's master plan apparent begin to come to fruition. The value of Carne village and especially the political value of his alter ego Momon are reaffirmed; the “hidden” genius of his actions is continuously met with shock and awe by Demiurge, Albedo, the rest of his guardians, and even Ains himself at his “great wisdom.” His attempts to act in a way befitting the ruler of Nazarick, continuing to further cement his guardian’s loyalty, push him ever further down the path of not-so-intentional world domination. Without human conscience due to being undead, he is motivated only to continue searching for other players from Yggdrasil and to gain power to better protect the children and home of him and his forty former companions. Lord Ains Ooal Gown maintains his mantle of Overlord and leads the Great Tomb of Nazarick unto the world stage, directly into a vicious power struggle between two great empires.

Con le sue fondamenta ora impostate in questo nuovo mondo, i primi passi del master plan di Ains Ooal Gown apparentemente cominciano a dare i loro frutti. Il valore del villaggio di Carne e soprattutto il valore politico del suo alter ego Momon sono riaffermati; il genio di Hidden delle sue azioni è continuamente incontrato con shock e awe da Demiurge, Albedo, il resto dei suoi guardiani, e anche Ains stesso alla sua grande saggezza. I suoi tentativi di agire in un modo che si addice al sovrano di Nazarick, continuando a cementare ulteriormente la sua fedeltà guardiana, lo spingono sempre più lungo il cammino della dominazione non così intenzionale del mondo. Senza la coscienza umana dovuta all'essere non morto, è motivato solo a continuare a cercare altri giocatori da Yggdrasil e ad ottenere il potere di proteggere meglio i bambini e la casa di lui e dei suoi quaranta ex compagni. Lord Ains Ooal Gown mantiene il mantello di Overlord e conduce la Grande Tomba di Nazarick alla scena mondiale, direttamente in una lotta di potere viziosa tra due grandi imperi.
101922: It is the Taisho Period in Japan. Tanjiro, a kindhearted boy who sells charcoal for a living, finds his family slaughtered by a demon. To make matters worse, his younger sister Nezuko, the sole survivor, has been transformed into a demon herself. Though devastated by this grim reality, Tanjiro resolves to become a “demon slayer” so that he can turn his sister back into a human, and kill the demon that massacred his family.

È il periodo di Taisho in Giappone. Tanjiro, un ragazzo di buon cuore che vende carbone per vivere, trova la sua famiglia macellata da un demone. Per peggiorare le cose, la sorella minore Nezuko, l'unica sopravvissuta, è stata trasformata in un demone. Anche se devastato da questa triste realtà, Tanjiro decide di diventare un assassino di Demon in modo da poter trasformare sua sorella in un essere umano, e uccidere il demone che ha massacrato la sua famiglia.
102370: The sixth season of Pororo, many episodes take place in the Summer Islands.
102434: Minion by Rabbit MACHINE and Tsubura is an aesthetic loop animation with music.
102498: When Keith is abducted and a friend from Koku's past resurfaces, Killer B returns and everyone is pulled into a conspiracy involving the crown.
Quando Keith viene rapito e un amico del passato di Koku riaffiora, Killer B ritorna e tutti vengono trascinati in una cospirazione che coinvolge la corona.
102562: The continuation of Hua Jianghu Zhi Buliang Ren
102626: Short animation by Keiichi Tanaami from 2001.
102690: Run & Roll is a campaign film created by Keiichi Tanaami for the Kyoto Marathon by CW-X.
102882: The popular Iroha Igarashi and reclusive Hikari Tsutsui continue to navigate the tumultuous waters of young love and what it means to be true to yourself. As their relationship grows and deepens, new and difficult challenges threaten to break them apart. While they are committed to overcoming everything that comes their way as a couple, somethings may be too much for them to conquer.

La popolare Iroha Igarashi e la solitaria Hikari Tsutsui continuano a navigare nelle tumultuose acque del giovane amore e ciò che significa essere fedeli a se stessi. Mentre la loro relazione cresce e si approfondisce, nuove e difficili sfide minacciano di romperle. Mentre sono impegnati a superare tutto ciò che viene loro modo come una coppia, qualcosa può essere troppo per loro per vincere.
102946: Original "chibi" styled animations of Imouto sae Ireba Ii. posted on the anime's official Twitter.
103010: A Fukuoka City commissioned commercial from Tekken during their anti-drunk driving campaign.
103138:
An old man is trying to create a girl out of his memories. Little by little the doll is being made and given a physical body of machinery parts. The old man makes her as a pure creature, but she denies her identification. The doll demolishes herself, saying, “This is not Me!”

1st Year Work 2010 by Saya Fukase, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.
103330:
Dogs all end up to be a dusty dog. Dogs’ dust consists of pride of themselves and that of you.

The film is of the memory, love and gratitude of the dusty dog, and many other dogs, tracing their senses and memories, dedicating to you who gave love to them.
103522: Sentimental commercials involving towels told in a cyclic manner.
103714: The shorts tell the story of two twin princesses, Berry and Flora, whose mother died giving birth to them. The two grow up until their father chooses Berry to don the title of "Onaka Hime," or Stomach Princess, who is endowed with the power to heal the kingdom's citizens of illness and make its women beautiful through using BifiX 1000. Flora is disheartened at not being chosen, yet continues her studies. When it seems Berry is yet unable to use the powers of BifiX 1000 to heal a woman who is ill, Flora steals the product to try to do it herself. When Berry finds out what Flora is up to, she takes the product back before Flora has a chance to try to use it.
103970: This time G.G. Bond has transformed into an angel. He's on a 3 month trial period to help a monster to make sure they stay on the right path.
104162: Gamba, a town mouse with a brave, adventurous spirit decides to go on an adventure to discover the ocean. On his way, he meets a troubled child mouse, Chuta. He says his family and other mice have been killed by a clan of weasels living on a nearby island. Chuta asks a group of ship mice, the bravest of their kind, for help, but when they find out that the villain behind this event is the terrifying weasel-leader Noroi, they give up on helping Chuta. However seeing the hopeless Chuta, Gamba promises him to save the island, his family and the other mice. Gamba and his friends team up to go on their adventure to defeat the evil Noroi and his clan.
104354:
Spring, the fox is in the middle of a party. Workers' family of raccoon dogs reveal their field work during the hot summer and harvest autumn. A fox who stupidly hunts the Raccoon dumplings carrying the harvest with perspiration, before the raccoon dog wears it, takes away the food of the rabbit. A cold winter comes. The Raccoon family is having a good time around the hearth, but the fox is troubled with food and wandering in the snow. The fox intends a collective battle, raises a fire from the fire, causes a fire, and tries to rob the storage of the raccoon warehouse. A raccoon dog that turns into a truck and turns a fox that escaped a storage, turns it into a rainbow and chases it. The fight between the fox and the raccoon dog begins with a transformation.
